entities.summary: Benjamin James Clyde is an American retired basketball player. Born in Albany, Georgia, he played for Florida State University. He was selected by the Boston Celtics in the 5th round of the 1974 NBA draft, then played for the Celtics (1974–75) in the NBA for 25 games.
